mapper.select: select c.conversation_id as id, max(c.joined_at) as createdAt, max(case when c.role < 2 then c.user_id end) as agent from conversation_members c where c.conversation_id in ( select conversation_id from conversation_members where user_id = #{id} ) group by c.conversation_id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.id) c.id, cm_cs.unread_count, cm_user.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, CAST(u.id AS text)) AS userName, c.last_message_time AS lastMessageTime, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.last_message AS lastMessage, c.order_id AS orderId, cm_cs.user_id AS currentCsId, COALESCE(cs.nick_name, cs.user_name, CAST(cs.id AS text)) AS currentCsName FROM conversation_members cm_cs INNER JOIN conversations c ON cm_cs.conversation_id = c.id INNER JOIN conversation_members cm_user ON cm_user.conversation_id = c.id AND cm_user.user_id != cm_cs.user_id AND cm_user.role = 2 LEFT JOIN users u ON cm_user.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users cs ON cm_cs.user_id = cs.id WHERE cm_cs.user_id = #{currentUserId}
-- ⚠️ 关键：先按 c.id 分组，再按时间倒序 ORDER BY c.id, c.last_message_time DESC
